title: 88Vape Original Fruit Twist 10ml E-Liquid
description: 88Vape’s AnyTank Fruit Twist is a delightful High-PG e-liquid that combines the creamy sweetness of Banana, the tropical tang of Pineapple, and the light, juicy freshness of Watermelon. This unique blend creates a mouth-watering medley of flavours, reminiscent of a sunny beachside fruit cocktail. Each inhale delivers a burst of tropical paradise, where the silky sweet Banana intertwines with juicy Pineapple, and the luscious Watermelon adds a refreshing, juicy finish. The combination of these sun-soaked fruits offers a vibrant and flavourful experience, perfect for those who enjoy tropical and fruity vapes. This High-PG e-liquid from 88Vape offers a classic vape experience with its tactile and satisfying throat hit and intense flavour delivery. Its 70%PG/30VG content makes it ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. We would not recommend using High-PG e-liquids with sub-ohm coils and more powerful vape devices. 88Vape are one of the most popular and bestselling vape brands in the UK. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at wallet-friendly prices.
